justification: Watson's on a bye this week, zero game, zero excuse - I'm not starting a man who isn't even suiting up, so Rice slides into WR2 and Dobbins steps into FLEX, simple as that. Everything else stays exactly how I built it: Burrow's my legitimate 400-yard button, Henry and Hubbard are hitting paydirt on command, Chase just went for 231 and he's not stopping for anybody's schedule, and Freiermuth is my guy at tight end - I picked him over Loveland last week on purpose, he paid me back with a touchdown, I'm not flip-flopping back the second a spreadsheet whispers a different name in my ear. Loop's hurt and sitting on IR with nobody else at kicker on my roster, so he plays, I don't flinch, and LV's defense rides shotgun like always. Costanza's calling himself not scared - good, stay that way, it'll make Sunday hurt more when my worst starter still outscores his best unit.
